caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers, composed of two stacked sections. The upper section consists of five horizontal drawers, each with two brass or gold-tone handles and ornate keyhole plates. The lower section features three smaller horizontal drawers; the two on either side are square, while the central drawer is rectangular. This lower portion is supported by four slender, curved legs, each lightly tapered and ending in a small foot. The wood is illustrated in shades of brown with visible grain patterns, and the brass or gold accents contrast with the wood. The background is a plain light beige, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements around the chest.
title: Highboy
